coussin-air.description: Air cushions for void fill and protection in boxes. Extremely light, quickly inflated on an SPK machine, resistant to shocks and vibration. Available made to measure, from everyday void fill to bulky products.

devidoir-ergonomique.name: Ergonomic stretch film dispenser
devidoir-ergonomique.description: The Vianex ergonomic dispenser is an improved version of the classic stretch film applicator, with a built-in adjustable tension brake for precise control of film tension while wrapping. film-etirable-biodegradable-pla.name: Biodegradable PLA stretch film
film-etirable-biodegradable-pla.description: Vianex biodegradable PLA stretch film is the eco-friendly packaging solution for companies looking to reduce their plastic footprint. Made from polylactic acid (PLA) derived from renewable resources (corn starch), it is certified industrially compostable in under 90 days under EN 13432. Its mechanical performance matches standard PE film: same ease of use, same pre-stretch, same transparency.

Thickness 23 µm, width 500 mm, length 250 m
Mechanical performance equal to PE film
Works with existing 500 mm hand applicators
Lower carbon footprint for your packaging operations
A CSR commitment you can show clients and partners
No changes to existing equipment needed
Compostable — less plastic waste in landfill

film-etirable-imprime-personnalise.name: Custom printed stretch film
film-etirable-imprime-personnalise.description: Vianex custom printed stretch film turns your palletising into a brand communication tool. Your brand visible on the whole wrapped pallet

film-etirable-machine-17my.name: 17 µm machine stretch film
film-etirable-machine-17my.description: Vianex 17 µm machine stretch film is designed for high-speed automatic and semi-automatic stretch wrappers. With pre-stretch of up to 300%, this long film (1,500 m per roll) drastically reduces film consumption while keeping pallets securely contained. Its high-quality LLDPE formula gives very consistent pre-stretch and few breaks, essential on automated production lines.

Width 500 mm, length 1,500 m — long run time
Up to 300% pre-stretch for maximum film savings

Its ultra-reinforced LLDPE formula gives exceptional tear and puncture resistance while keeping a high pre-stretch of up to 300%.
